Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State, apprised the Court that on 27.8.2023 notice has been served to the informant of the case.
2. Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

3. Heard Sri Rajesh Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA,
for the State.
4.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.56 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Rasulabad, District Kanpur Dehat during pendency of the trial.

5. FIR of the present case was lodged against unknown persons under Section 363 IPC and Sandeep Chaturvedi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33586456/

sentences.text: 1 according to the FIR, some unknown persons have enticed the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant was not named in the FIR but when the victim was recovered and her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. was recorded then she stated that she had gone along with applicant according to her own wish and thereafter applicant was made accused in the present matter.
7. He further submits that victim in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. repeated her earlier version recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
8.

He further submits that during investigation victim refused for her internal examination and,
therefore, her ossification test could not be conducted but even from her school record it appears that she was around 17 years old at the time of incident and, therefore, it appears to be a case of love affair.

9. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 23.3.2023, i.e., for almost six months.
10.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayerfor bail and submits that although victim did not make allegation of rape against the applicant in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. but in her both the statements she stated that physical relationships were developed between applicant and her and according to her school record she was around 17 years old at the time of incident, therefore, it cannot be said that applicant did not commit offence of rape.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. Although as per school record victim was around 17 years old at the time of incident but admittedly during investigation her ossification test was not conducted and in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. she categorically stated that she had gone along with applicant and from her both the statements it appears to be a case of love affair.
13. Law is settled that bail application should not be dismissed either for punitive or preventive purposes.
14. Applicant is not having any previous criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since March, 2023, i.e., for almost six months.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
Let the applicant-Sandeep Chaturvedi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
